reviewNotes: bpacnz gives every 4 to 6 hours; KidsHealth and Healthify give at least 4 hours. 4 hours is used.
bpacnz: significantly underweight or malnourished children may need 10 mg/kg or longer gaps. The app shows a prompt; it does not change the numbers.

sources.name: KidsHealth NZ: Safe use of paracetamol in children
bpacnz: Paracetamol dosing for children in primary care (2018)

reviewNotes: Healthify's 2026 pages say every 6 to 8 hours, no more than 3 times in 24 hours. Its 2022 ibuprofen page allows 3 or 4 times a day (4 hours apart at 4 times). The newer, more cautious figures are used; the reviewer must decide.
Interval uses the lower end (6 hours) of the 6 to 8 hour range.
maxMgPer24h (1200) and maxMgPerKgPer24h (30) are 3 doses at the stated per-dose maxima; no source states them directly.
minWeightKg (5) comes from PLAN.md and no source has been found. Unused in tracker mode.
mgPerKg: Healthify gives 5 to 10 mg/kg; its calculator uses 6 mg/kg per National HealthPathways. Unused in tracker mode.
NZ Formulary for Children not yet checked: it requires accepting licence terms.
